changelog:
- Fokk Mesh 2.0 Architecture: Complete rewrite of the mesh routing engine. Circuit pre-warming pool eliminates per-request handshake latency — circuits are ready before you click.
- Signed Node Manifest: Node list is now cryptographically signed by the Fokk team. Any tampered or unsigned manifest is rejected. No unknown or unverified servers ever used.
- Latency-Ranked Node Selection: All nodes are probed in parallel on startup. Only the fastest live nodes are used. Dead nodes are automatically excluded for 5 minutes.
- Node Registry: Single source of truth for all relay data. Live manifest (24-hour cached) with certified builtin fallback. All 15 builtin nodes SSL-verified.
- Legal Compliance: Removed all unverified random public proxy entries. Only explicitly registered Fokk relay nodes and SSL-verified servers are in any routing table.
- Killswitch: If all circuits fail, the browser receives a 407 response. Traffic never falls through to a direct connection. No IP leaks under any failure mode.
